source_law.title: Walking along and upon highways (2)
source_law.text: Except as otherwise provided in subsection 6 [NRS-484B-297-6], pedestrians walking along highways where sidewalks are not provided shall walk on the left side of those highways facing the approaching traffic.

source_topic_inventory.text: Except as otherwise provided in subsection 6 [NRS-484B-297-6], pedestrians walking along highways where sidewalks are not provided shall walk on the left side of those highways facing the approaching traffic.
Pedestrian highway travel with approaching traffic

Subsection 6 permits a sidewalk traveler encountering an obstruction to enter the immediately adjacent highway with due care, near the sidewalk, and return as soon as practicable. This is a separate activation path; both selected subsection 2 drafts require sourced absence of a sidewalk and sourced absence of subsection 6 obstruction.
